object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Take a document whose manifest defines type, status and rationale, holding a heading and a requirement below it, and validate it. Then add to the requirement's file an attribute named unknown, which the manifest doesn't define, and validate again. Expected: no validation error the first time; ATTR_UNKNOWN the second time.
